title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00088 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 02:15: R/u cutting machine cut tensioner joint. Needed to change knifes due to jamming. Significant wave height between 2,4m and 2,8m r/d cutting machine
02:15 - 02:30: Performed TBT for l/o tensioner joint and multibowl.
02:30 - 02:45: R/u equipment for l/o tensioner joint and multibowl.
02:45 - 03:30: L/o tensioner joint and multibowl removed multibowl RT and nt2 connector.
03:30 - 04:15: Removed handling tools and nt2 connector r/d elevator. Connected bails to manual elevator.
04:15 - 05:15: Pulled upper pup and splash zone joint cleaned riser on centralizer deck. Installed elevator on masterbushing and landed off riser.
05:15 - 06:00: R/u cutting machine cut riser. Significant wave height 2,1m. R/d cutting machine
06:00 - 06:15: L/o splash zone joint
06:15 - 06:45: Pulled riser installed master bushing and elevator. Landed off riser onto elevator.
06:45 - 07:15: R/u cutting machine cut riser joint. Significant wave height 1,6m. R/d cutting machine. Meanwhile performed TBT for l/o riser joint.
07:15 - 08:00: Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator. Riser out of splash zone at 0800.
08:00 - 08:30: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine
08:30 - 09:00: L/o riser joint Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed off riser onto elevator.
09:00 - 09:45: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine.
09:45 - 10:15: L/o riser joint Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed off riser onto elevator.
10:15 - 11:00: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine meanwhile performed TBT for installing hatches
11:00 - 11:30: L/o riser joint l/o last joint
11:30 - 11:45: Installed hatches. Removed scaffolding end of report
